draft.shortGloss: to teach; to educate; to mark
draft.emotion: authoritative yet patient, like a teacher explaining something clearly to a student
notes: Used when you give someone knowledge or skills.
Differs from 'دَرَّسَ' (darrasa), which specifically refers to giving a class or lesson. 'عَلَّمَ' is more general and focuses on the success of the learning process.

senses.definition: To help someone learn a skill or gain knowledge by giving them information or instruction.

examples.translation: My teacher taught me the Arabic language.
examples.emotion: grateful and appreciative when reflecting on a mentor

senses.definition: To make a mark or a sign on something so that it can be identified later.

examples.translation: The carpenter marked the cutting place with a pencil.
examples.emotion: precise and focused, careful to get the measurement right
